_comment: T-719 tutorial-capstone boss 2 — the climax, and the payoff for q_tut_03's interrupt lesson. Mechanic is training_dirge, NOT the crypt's dirge: the crypt version pulses dirge_damage EVERY tick across the whole channel (T-540 one-shot a L1 mage); training_dirge lands ONE token hit at channel end, so eating it costs 20 of a L2's ~105 HP and is survivable every single time. ROLE-FREE by construction: the wind-up breaks on a dedicated interrupt (warrior Pummel / mage Counterspell) OR on dirge_interrupt_damage 24 of damage inside the 3s window — the damage path is what a priest, who has no interrupt, uses, and 24 is inside a single L2 Emberstrike, under two L2 Smites, and well under the 30 a deliberately pessimistic 10 dps model lands across the whole window. Elite chassis at the same modest multipliers as Ost (stamina 9 => 95 HP x3.7 = 351 (raised from x3/285 on 2026-08-08: combat_ledger 3p clear was 11s, under the 12s trivial floor; now ~13-14s), 6 dmg / 2.5s). retaliate_only for the same reason as Ost: this anchor is 4m off the spine corridor a player walks to reach the side crypt, so proximity aggro would start the climax by accident. render_kind reuses the skeletal-warrior silhouette; mob_id is the unique alias q_tut_04 and dungeon_schedule.json key on.
